layer: Real Tauri WKWebView with isolated native filesystem vault
observed: Library main outline view, not inspector outline tab, renders existing multiline topics fully.
Enter creates a sibling and transfers input focus immediately; existing text is preserved.
Native composition of b/c consumes Tab while composing and Return commits bc without a new node; a subsequent Tab creates a child.
Child textarea receives multiline text; Shift+Tab outdents while retaining focus.
Two Shift+Enter presses append blank lines and grow the focused textarea.
Clicking the existing topic and typing 1 at the end preserves its original text.
Automatic save agrees with native file readback.
After application quit/relaunch, map view and main outline both show saved topics and the full multiline value.
